title: import_table_v1 — manifest contract for genome-atlas table imports
description: Validates POST /api/actions when type='import_table'. Pure file-IO action: reads a tabular file (TSV/CSV/JSON) from the workspace and emits a staging_genome_table_v0 envelope. Used for assembly metrics, BRAKER summaries, TE-density tracks, synteny block tables — anywhere the producer is an external pipeline and the atlas just needs the result indexed.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the file to import.

subject.description: Short tag for what this table is (e.g. 'assembly_metrics', 'braker_summary', 'te_density').
